THU AUG 27, 4:00 AM PT RUN.

WHAT IS LIVE THIS RUN: Google reviews (BOTH listings, exact counts via the reply queue), Gmail across Toast, Sling, Google Ads, Yelp, TripAdvisor and SpotHopper.
WHAT IS NOT: Wednesday Aug 26 Toast numbers (email had not sent), Thursday Aug 27 Sling roster (email had not sent), Google Ads and Yelp Ads dashboards (not scraped -- carried from Aug 26), Business Profile management requests, reservations.

1. DAY 19 -- FOOD SAFETY ALLEGATION, CONFIRMED STILL LIVE. Donald Clay, 1 star, The Brewhouse listing, posted Aug 8: 'Beer was not good at all. Got botulism from taco. Recovering now. Avoid this place.' This run walked the reply queue and saw it at position 5 of 6 with an empty reply box, so this is verified, not assumed. Nineteen days public and unanswered on a 528-review profile. A draft is staged that acknowledges, moves the conversation offline to (805) 884-4664 / mojobrewhouse@gmail.com, and states food-safety standards without admitting or denying causation. Get a legal or insurance read if you want one, but do not let it sit another day silent -- silence on a specific illness claim reads as concession.

2. REVIEW QUEUE, EXACT AND VERIFIED. THE BREWHOUSE 6 unreplied: Justin Ladner 5* (day 4), R. Muller 5* (day 5), sergio salazar 5* (day 11), Betty Chambers 5* (day 19), Donald Clay 1* (day 19), John Rinaldo 1* (day 33). BREWHOUSE COFFEE 2 unreplied: Debra Wedlake 5* (day 3), Geoff Lay 5* (day 12). Eight total. Four of the six 5-star reviews are past a week -- the thank-yous are the cheapest wins on this list and they are aging out. Note the Unreplied tab in the Business Profile panel only shows two rows and undercounts; the reply queue is the reliable read.

3. TUESDAY AUG 25, FULL DETAIL. Net $5,510.60 / gross $6,015.90 / 215 guests / 160 orders / 169 checks. vs SDLW: net +28.7%, gross +34.0%, guests +18.8%, orders +19.4%, avg order +7.8% to $34.44. vs 4-Tuesday avg: net +20.3%. Dinner carried it at $3,998.65 net (72.5%). Front Patio is the efficiency standout at $96.47 net per order. Draft Beer 144 items / $1,171.00 net, Liquor 81 items / $1,012.00.

4. LABOR, THIRD DAY OVER TARGET. 29.3% of net vs 25.0% SDLW and 24.2% on the 4-week. Hourly labor cost $1,614.76, up 51.1% vs SDLW's $1,068.66 -- labor grew nearly twice as fast as sales. Sequence is 39.8%, 28.8%, 29.3%. Overtime has been zero four days running, so this is not an OT problem: it is bodies scheduled outside the revenue windows. Dinner produced 72.5% of net; the schedule should follow that.

5. DISCOUNTS -- NEW AND SPECIFIC. $505.30, 8.4% of gross, +145.7% vs SDLW's $205.64 and +77.2% vs the 4-week. Expresso Service accounts for $280.40 of it, taking $507.00 gross to $226.60 net -- a 55% discount rate on that daypart. Add $250.00 of gift cards fully discounted. Worth pulling the discount-reason report. Voids by contrast are clean: $54.75 on 5 items, DOWN 3.9% vs SDLW. Refunds zero.

6. STAFFING BLIND TODAY. The Thursday Aug 27 Sling report sends at 7:00 AM; this run is at 4:00 AM. No roster, no uncovered count, no OT flag. Wednesday ran 8 employees / 36.00 hours with ONE COOK for a second straight day. If Thursday repeats that, check it against tonight's covers before service.

7. ADS. No dashboard scrape this run. Email side: two Google Ads report emails (Aug 26), no disapprovals, no budget alerts. The unresolved item is unchanged and needs a human in the account -- both Performance Max campaigns read 'All asset groups limited by policy', so the restaurant side serves nothing even if unpaused. The coffee Search campaign was the only earner and its CPC had quadrupled to $2.40 as of Aug 25. Nothing from TripAdvisor. Yelp email was marketing only, but the business inbox has sat at 15 unread since Aug 21 -- six days.

8. OPEN TICKET. SpotHopper acknowledged a support ticket on Aug 24 for 'Google Ads conversion tag missing on sbbrewhouse.com'. No resolution email since. That tag matters for measuring the very campaigns above -- worth a nudge.
